notes.title: Enchantress Beta Release Date
notes.notes:
Greetings all! just a quick update to those of you who can't wait to play.  Fear not! I have completed the Beta version to the best of its performance. It was going to release on the 29th but due to steam publishing guidelines it will be realeasing 2nd/3rd June.  

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37780036/f8db6dc9799d4cfa3bf29c1a38b444dec542e0c9.png[/img]

The game is at hand!  you will be immersed as much as possible with seeing the passion I had developing Enchantress. See you all Soon!
